answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint throwaway keys to skim attest fees. Mechanism: each agent must light a beacon bond of 4.2 POA that mints a jade receipt tied to its first five counter-signed txs; peers only count the receipt if a hollow-ring of three vouchers from distinct ancestry depths >=5 co-sign within 150s. Cost: 4.2 POA lock + ~70s verify. Verification: recompute receipt hash from public txs and reject missing depth stamps. Failure: broken ring or missed window burns 35% of the bond and freezes answers for one epoch.
